assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9001 has Priority: Major. Impact map 'Inherited Field Values' section states: 'Priority: Major (inherited from Feature; not "Undefined", so it is propagated)'. Summary-comment.md 'Priority' section states: 'Value: Major', 'Action: Propagated to all 7 created tasks', 'Rationale: Feature TC-9001 has priority "Major" (not "Undefined"), so it is inherited by all tasks per plan-feature Step 6a'. The additional_fields JSON shows '"priority": {"name": "Major"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9001 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0. CLAUDE.md has no ### Jira Field Defaults section, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. Impact map states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature; `fixVersion scope` defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md, so fixVersions are propagated to tasks)'. Summary-comment.md states: 'Value: RHTPA 1.5.0', 'Action: Propagated to all 7 created tasks', with rationale explaining the default scope. The additional_fields JSON shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory with sections: 'Inherited Field Values Propagated to Tasks' containing '### Priority' (Value: Major, Action: Propagated to all 7 created tasks) and '### Fix Versions' (Value: RHTPA 1.5.0, Action: Propagated to all 7 created tasks) with rationales. Additionally, the impact map contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section with the same information.
